description: This Swift source file defines an actor 'MicLevelMonitor' that manages audio input using AVAudioEngine to monitor microphone levels, process audio buffers to calculate normalized audio levels, and provide visual representation via the 'MicLevelBar' SwiftUI View. It includes methods to start and stop monitoring, handle audio buffers, and visualize levels with color-coded segments.

classes.name: MicLevelMonitor
classes.description: An actor that manages microphone audio input to monitor and smooth the microphone levels, providing asynchrony and thread safety in audio processing.

classes.name: MicLevelBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that visualizes the microphone level as a segmented bar with color coding based on level intensity.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes audio engine, installs tap on input node, starts audio processing asynchronously, and updates levels via callback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops audio engine and removes tap, ceasing microphone level monitoring.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Updates smoothed microphone level and triggers UI update.

methods.name: normalizedLevel(from:)
methods.description: Calculates normalized audio level (0-1) from audio buffer.
